topic: Interior Lighting Sub System - Door Lamp Fading and Blinking Control
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific blinking rate or fading speed command for the front right door ambient lamp.

column_semantics.Code Value: Identifier for the specific blinking rate or fading speed command.
column_semantics.Period: The time interval for the blinking cycle or fading duration.
column_semantics.Original Breathing Mode Value: The corresponding breathing mode value from the original system specification.

core_entities.name: DoorFR5LampFadeSpdCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command to set the fading speed of the front right door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorFR6LampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Command to turn the front right door ambient lamp on or off.

core_entities.name: DoorFR6LampColCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command to set the color of the front right door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: RHZCU
core_entities.description: Right Hand Zone Control Unit, responsible for controlling the ambient lighting functions.

core_entities.name: DoorAmbtLampF_FR
core_entities.description: Front Right Door Ambient Lamp Function module.

core_entities.name: RHZCU_LIN4
core_entities.description: LIN bus interface for communication with the RHZCU.

core_entities.name: 内灯SSTS
core_entities.description: Interior Lighting Sub System Specification, part of the overall vehicle lighting control system.

core_conditions.name: Blinking Rate
core_conditions.description: Defined by the 'Code Value' and 'Period' columns, specifying how fast the lamp blinks.

core_conditions.name: Fading Speed
core_conditions.description: Defined by the 'DoorFR5LampFadeSpdCmd_1' signal values (0x0 to 0x3), specifying how quickly the lamp fades in or out.

core_conditions.name: On/Off State
core_conditions.description: Defined by the 'DoorFR6LampOnOff_1' signal values (0x0 for OFF, 0x1 for ON).

core_conditions.name: Color Command
core_conditions.description: Defined by the 'DoorFR6LampColCmd_1' signal, specifying the desired color of the lamp when turned on.

core_outputs.name: DoorAmbtLampF_FR
core_outputs.description: The actual blinking and fading behavior of the front right door ambient lamp as controlled by the RHZCU.

core_timing_constraints.name: Blinking Period
core_timing_constraints.description: Defined in the 'Period' column, ranging from 500ms to 12s for different blinking rates.

core_timing_constraints.name: Fading Speed
core_timing_constraints.description: Defined by the 'DoorFR5LampFadeSpdCmd_1' signal, with default speed at 2000ms and options for faster speeds.

core_timing_constraints.name: Transition Time
core_timing_constraints.description: Time required for the lamp to transition from current state to target state during color or brightness change.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the parameters and commands for controlling the blinking and fading behavior of the front right door ambient lamp within the Interior Lighting Sub System. It specifies various blinking rates, fading speeds, and on/off states that can be commanded via the RHZCU through the LIN bus interface.
uncertain_points: The exact mapping between the 'Original Breathing Mode Value' and the new blinking rates is not fully explained.
The specific timing relationship between the blinking rate and the fading speed is not detailed.
